integrity: The all-order claim uses a symbolic proof. Exhaustive finite checks cover full reflexive-relation spaces only through order four, while code enumeration covers orders two through five. No independent or formal validation has occurred.
scientific_limitations: Only finite meet-chain semigroups in the single-operation signature; no claim about arbitrary branching semilattices or Clifford semigroups. Equivalent older formulations using compatible grid relations remain a historical-overlap risk.
title: Diagonal relations of finite meet-chains: a product-of-chains theorem
